title: Trivago hotel listings
description: Public Trivago hotel listing records extracted for hotel research, market analysis, price comparison, and lead-generation workflows.

hotelName.title: Hotel name
hotelName.description: Hotel or accommodation name as shown publicly on Trivago.

hotelUrl.title: Hotel URL
hotelUrl.description: Public Trivago hotel detail URL when available.

trivagoUrl.title: Trivago URL
trivagoUrl.description: Public Trivago URL for the hotel listing.

city.title: City
city.description: City parsed from public Trivago location context when available.

country.title: Country
country.description: Country parsed from public Trivago location context when available.

address.title: Address
address.description: Public address when visible on the listing page.

guestRating.title: Guest rating
guestRating.description: Public guest rating shown by Trivago.

reviewCount.title: Review count
reviewCount.description: Public review count shown by Trivago.

price.title: Price
price.description: Public price shown on the Trivago listing card when available.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Currency visible on the public Trivago page.

pricePerNight.title: Price per night
pricePerNight.description: Public listing-card price per night when available.

checkIn.title: Check-in
checkIn.description: Input check-in date recorded for downstream workflows.

checkOut.title: Check-out
checkOut.description: Input check-out date recorded for downstream workflows.

bookingProvider.title: Booking provider
bookingProvider.description: Primary booking provider if publicly visible on the listing card.

providerUrl.title: Provider URL
providerUrl.description: Provider URL if publicly visible on the listing card.

allVisibleProviders.title: All visible providers
allVisibleProviders.description: Provider names visible on the listing card when available.

providerCount.title: Provider count
providerCount.description: Count of visible booking sites or advertisers when Trivago exposes the count.

imageUrl.title: Image URL
imageUrl.description: Public hotel image URL when visible.

amenities.title: Amenities
amenities.description: Public amenity-like listing text when visible.

visibleHighlights.title: Visible highlights
visibleHighlights.description: Public listing highlights shown by Trivago.

hotelDescription.title: Hotel description
hotelDescription.description: Short public description or listing highlights when available.
hotelDescription.example: Exceptional breakfast with a view; Panoramic city views from every room

rankingPosition.title: Ranking position
rankingPosition.description: Position of the hotel in the public Trivago listing results.

sourceSearchUrl.title: Source search URL
sourceSearchUrl.description: Public Trivago destination URL used as the source.

scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
scrapedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the row was created.
